channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Vehicle fire shuts down northbound I-275 on Sunshine Skyway Bridge: FHP
item.description: Florida Highway Patrol (FHP) troopers and fire rescue crews responded Monday morning to a vehicle fire that has shut down northbound Interstate 275 on the Sunshine Skyway Bridge.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco deputies searching for missing Wesley Chapel woman: PSO
item.description: Pasco County deputies are searching for a missing 46-year-old woman last seen in Wesley Chapel, according to the Pasco Sheriff's Office (PSO).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'They call 15 times a day': Seniors inundated with Medicare calls ahead of open enrollment
item.description: One woman who receives calls about her Medicare every day warns others about the red flags of fraudulent Medicare calls, texts and emails.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] HCSO investigating death of Falkenburg Road Jail inmate
item.description: The Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office (HCSO) is investigating the death of an inmate at the Falkenburg Road Jail, according to the agency.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US strikes Iran again as retaliation raises fears over gas prices, Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The U.S. military has struck Iran for the first time in weeks, and Iran has fired back with ballistic missiles. Now the world is watching — and so are energy markets.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 1 dead and about 15 people may be missing as flash flood tears through the Grand Canyon
item.description: A deadly flash flood has torn through the Grand Canyon, killing 1 person and leaving about 15 others missing. Dozens have been evacuated and a key water pipeline is down ahead of Labor Day weekend

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Police in Switzerland make arrest after deadly rave shooting
item.description: A suspect is in custody after a shooting at a rave in Switzerland killed a 22-year-old Italian woman and wounded five others.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Police searching for hit-and-run driver after e-bike crash in St. Petersburg: SPPD
item.description: Police are searching for a driver who fled after striking a man riding an e-bike early Monday morning in St. Petersburg, according to the St. Petersburg Police Department (SPPD).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jet skier dies after lightning strike near Fort De Soto Park: PCSO
item.description: A man died Saturday evening after being struck by lightning while riding a jet ski near Fort De Soto Park, according to the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office (PCSO).

item.title: [WATCHLIST: tropical storm] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Dolly remnants, Gulf system could bring rain to drought-hit Florida
item.description: FOX 13 meteorologists are tracking two areas of interest in the tropics Monday, including a disturbance in the northern Gulf and the remnants of former Tropical Storm Dolly near Puerto Rico.
